name: Carlotta

tierList.prydwen: T1 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Glacio Pistols Main DPS, first limited Glacio DPS and first 5-star Pistol user. Ranged Hypercarry whose Resonance Liberation fires 6 charges in sequence (Era of New Wave -> 4x Death Knell -> Fatal Finale, all counted as Resonance Skill DMG). Forte gauge 'Substance' (max 120) built via Moldable Crystals; at full Substance unlocks 'Final Bow' (+80% dmg multiplier on all Liberation hits) and an enhanced Heavy Attack that resets Skill cooldown.

skills.normalAttack: Silent Execution - 2-hit chain; 'Necessary Measures' variant with Moldable Crystals active.
skills.resonanceSkill: Art of Violence -> Chromatic Splendor combo (generates/consumes Moldable Crystals for Substance, inflicts Dispersion immobilize).
skills.forte: Lethal Repertoire - governs Substance/Final Bow and the enhanced Heavy Attack 'Imminent Oblivion' (Skill cooldown reduction).
skills.liberation: Era of New Wave - AoE Glacio (Skill-type) DMG + Deconstruction (18% DEF ignore) debuff, triggers Twilight Tango (6-hit Death Knell/Fatal Finale sequence).
skills.intro: Wintertime Aria - Glacio DMG, +30 Substance, +3 Moldable Crystals.
skills.outro: Closing Remark - Glacio DMG equal to ~794% ATK.

echoSet: Frosty Resolve (5pc, best, up to 70.5% total DMG Bonus)

teams.name: Team #1: Best Team
teams.notes: Zhezhi/Lynae are top buffers (up to 45% DMG Amp + Energy funneling); Mornye pairs specifically with Lynae.

teams.name: Team #2: F2P Team
teams.notes: Yangyang easier to pilot; Taoqi (38% Skill DMG Amp Outro) has higher ceiling but clunkier rotation.

rotation: Warm-up (if 0 Substance): Skill x2 for 30 Substance. Burst: Intro -> Skill (Art of Violence + Chromatic Splendor, Final Bow) -> Mid-air Attack -> Forte Heavy (Imminent Oblivion) -> Ultimate 6-hit sequence (Era of New Wave, Death Knell x4, Fatal Finale) -> Skill x2 (rebuild 30 Substance) -> Echo (swap cancel) -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: top-tier ranged Hypercarry DPS (T1 ToA) with huge Resonance-Skill-type burst damage via her 6-charge Ultimate sequence; downsides are long cooldowns requiring precise setup, mostly single-target focus, and her best Echo set (Frosty Resolve) being nearly exclusive to her. Weak in multi-wave Whimpering Wastes (T4) due to backloaded burst.
